title: Transduction of encoded argument lists
statement: For every finite list $A$ of natural numbers and every finite bit string $r$, processing the encoding of $A$ followed by $r$ from state $a$ leaves the encoded list unchanged and processes the suffix from state $g$: $T_a(	ext{encode}(A)Vert r)=	ext{encode}(A)Vert T_g(r)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite list of natural numbers
